text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As the end of summer camp draws near,
the
students are attending a night walk
as part of
their recreational activities.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While officially called a night walk, it's
more of a
"fright night" in practice. I've
come along to keep
watch of everyone.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I g-guess nighttime frights go
hand 'n' hand
with summer... S-sounds
like fun, right?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Specters or ghouls, whatever—I can
handle 'em
all!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Wh-whatta dumb question! Izzat some
kinda
joke?! Nothin' scares the mighty
Inari One!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
This'll be a piece of cake, just you
watch!

text_block_list.name: Student Organizer
text_block_list.text:
All right, once you've drawn your
partner from
the box, make your way to
the designated area!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Inari One's partner turns out to be
Tamamo
Cross—a gutsy runner born and
raised in Kansai
who's been steadily
climbing the ranks.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Like Inari One, her cheerful demeanor
makes her
rather dependable to others.
However...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Wh-whazza matter, Tama? You gettin'
scared or
somethin'? Gonna go cryin'
home to Mommy?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: O-oh please! We all know you're gonna be the one cryin'! I can already see ya shakin' under the covers!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Heh! Gimme a break! You're not foolin'
anyone
with the way your legs are
tremblin'!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ha! Ya hear that waver in your voice?!
You won't
last a second and ya know it!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Grrrr!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Grrrr!

text_block_list.name: Inari & Tamamo
text_block_list.text:
What wazzat?!
What was dat?!

text_block_list.name: Student Organizer
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross and Inari One, you're up
next. Bon
voyage!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Their faces still look a little tense.
Maybe there's
something I can suggest
to ease their nerves...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
S-sounds like advice Tama could use!
You're
always yellin' anyway, so why not
let 'er rip?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
What?! Try listenin' to yourself! You're
the one
screamin' all the time! Go on
and quit holdin'
back—I'll cover my ears!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, they begin their rowdy trek into
the
night...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Well, well, well! This is just what the
doctor
ordered! A nice relaxin' walk in
the healin'
ambience of nature!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
R-right with you on that one! Sooo quiet
and
relaxin'! Yep... My heart feels at
ease—

text_block_list.name: Obscure Noise
text_block_list.text: Rustle, rustle!

text_block_list.name: Inari & Tamamo
text_block_list.text: Hyeee!

text_block_list.name: Obscure Noise
text_block_list.text: Rustle, crack!

text_block_list.name: Inari & Tamamo
text_block_list.text: Gyaaah!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Wh-whazza matter with you?! Stop
squealin' like
a crazy person!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Y-you're da one who sounds like you're
gonna
cry!

text_block_list.name: Obscure Noise
text_block_list.text: Whoooosh!

text_block_list.name: Inari & Tamamo
text_block_list.text: AAAAAGH!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
The hell?! Why ya gotta scream so
loud?! I knew
you were a big ol'
fraidy-cat!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Aw, shut it! You're da one makin' me go deaf! I swear, bein' around scaredy-cats like you's bad for my health!

text_block_list.name: Obscure Noise
text_block_list.text: Rustle, rustle... WHOOOOSH!

text_block_list.name: Inari & Tamamo
text_block_list.text: HYAAAAAGH!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... W-we finally made it outta there...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... I thought I was gonna lose my voice...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Tama.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: ...Inari.

text_block_list.name: Inari & Tamamo
text_block_list.text:
Don't tell no one 'bout what happened
tonight?
Cool.
Don't tell nobody 'bout
what happened tonight?
Cool.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the quiet of the night, Inari One and
Tamamo
Cross share a secret summer
memory.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I bet you'd like that, wouldn't ya,
Tama?
Go ahead, set the pace and I'll
follow along! Ya
can thank me later!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Speak for yourself! You should thank me for chasin' after you when ya eventually get lost tryna escape!

the
night...

cry!

text_block_list.name: Obscure Noise
text_block_list.text: Whoooosh!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
H-hehe... It's okay. I know ya wanna
make a run
for it!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Quit tryna sound tough! You're
itchin' to
split, I can tell!

text_block_list.name: Obscure Noise
text_block_list.text: Rustle, rustle... WHOOOOSH!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... I'm completely... worn out...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... That mighta been da fastest I ever ran...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Tama.
